description: THE INVENTORY AXIS. 100 / 500 / 1,000 held stacks (70% resolving to NO component) across one crafting actor and 2 source actors, against a 5,000-component library and a pinned 20-recipe corpus.
ceiling: The recipe corpus is pinned at 6 BY DESIGN. evaluateCraftability is recipes x items x components — measured on this checkout at ~137 ms per recipe at 1,000 held stacks against 5,000 components, i.e. ~11 s for a 20-row open — so this profile varies inventory and nothing else, and keeps the row count low enough for the drift test to re-derive every count inside npm test. Its counterpart corpus axis lives in simple-corpus.

identity.resolveComponentForItem.miss@10.description: THE MISS CASE. Items with no Fabricate flags and no matching source reference, against a 5,000-component library: both durable tiers miss and the raw-reference tier scans the library in full before returning null.

identity.findMatchingComponent.miss@100.description: The same miss case through the FULL resolver including the name fallback — a SECOND complete library scan per item (essenceResolver -> componentNameMatch).

identity.resolveComponentForItem.hit@100.description: THE HIT CASE, kept separate on purpose. A durable roles-map flag resolves on tier 1; averaging it with the miss case above hides a two-orders-of-magnitude difference.

craftingEngine.findComponentItems@100.description: The craft/salvage execution matcher for ONE component: O(items x components), because itemResolvesToComponent re-runs full candidate resolution per item.

craftingEngine.findComponentItems.bulk@1.description: A bulk salvage/destroy run of 5 rows, which calls the matcher ONCE PER ROW — so the run is O(rows x items x components). Bounded at 5 rows because the product is already tens of millions of candidate examinations.

craftingListing.buildListing@100.description: The player crafting open at this inventory size. Corpus pinned at 20 recipes so the ONLY thing varying across the series is held-stack count.

inventoryListing.buildListing@100.description: The Inventory tab open at this inventory size, same pinned 20-row corpus.
